notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Changes on this patch:

-  Muting when game is not focused (windows)
-  More precise detection when grabbing your sword mid-jump

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[b]This updates fixes:[/b]

- enemies sometimes skipping the alert turn and shooting you without warning
- boss 3 sometimes getting invisible
- softlocking after entering certain rooms
- boss 1 sometimes not getting hit by a thrown sword

notes.title: Hit Prediction!!!
notes.content: After hearing from the community, now there's a hit prediction system which you can use to see if you'll hit an enemy on your next jump!

notes.title: Update 1.0.23
notes.content:
Fixed

- Upgrade descriptions on pause menu
- Reduced delay while warping on map
- Boss 2 stun lock
